Summary-level coverage.measured is null for lines/branches/functions although thresholds (90/85/90) are defined and the vite-plus plan report measured 92.06/85.2/90 (all met); the packages/desktop override also shows passed_count 0 of file_count 42 despite pass=true. Coverage data exists but the summary aggregation did not propagate it - review summary aggregation, not the test suites.

Rust plan report flags coverage.pass=false on branches: 0 vs threshold 85, but the CLI runs 'cargo llvm-cov --json' without --branch so every file reports branch count=0 (not measured, not 0% covered). The summary gate treating this dimension as pass matches null-dimension awareness; add --branch to the cargo llvm-cov invocation only if branch gating is actually wanted for rust.

Rust function coverage 90.75% barely clears the 90 threshold; the shortfall is concentrated in binary entry points src/main.rs and src/bin/export-bindings.rs (0% lines/functions, not exercised by unit tests) while workspace crates sit at 96%+ line coverage.
